notes.title: Version 1.7.1
Update 1.6.10
notes.notes:
Notes from update 1.6.10:

- Addition of sound effects (sound of doors opening and closing, sound of light switch, sound of footsteps).

- Addition of images to the notes of the barcelona pavilion.

- Changed position of the last note of the barcelona pavilion.

- Update of texts.

- Addition of a run button (shift).

- General bug fixes.

notes.title: Game release
notes.notes:
I am very pleased to announce the release of my game Architecture Zeitgeist on Steam! I would first like to thank DVIZ, who supported me since the beginning of the project and helped me bring this idea to reality.

I would also like to thank my friends and professors from FAU - UnB, who gave me support and valuable feedbacks throughout the game creation process.

Architecture Zeitgeist was created with much love and dedication, aiming to popularize and make the teaching of architecture more accessible. I hope players can learn and have fun visiting and interacting with the iconic works of architecture that are present in the game.

I would like to point out that the game is still in Early Access and I am open to feedbacks and suggestions from the community. Together we can make Zeitgeist Architecture even more complete and immersive.

Once again, I thank everyone who contributed to make this dream come true. I hope everyone can enjoy the game and learn more about the fascinating art of architecture. Thank you!

I would also like to inform you that I will soon be updating the store page to add a Road Map for future updates that are on the way.

Yours truly,
Matheus Rudo

notes.title: Version 1.6.7 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixes:

- Fixed the bug where the player could pause the game infinite times.
- Correction of the texts of the story mode.
- Fixed the bug where the player needed to press "E" 3 times to read any book.
- Added game translation for Spanish and French.
